title: 第337章 哥布林首领第338章 意外
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “咔嗬嗬，咔嗬嗬！”
就在战场呈现一边倒的屠杀之势时，哥布林阵营中突然传出一声震耳欲聋的嘶吼。
一道高大的身影缓缓站了出来，瞬间吸引了全场的目光。
在场的影焰哥布林普遍只有一米五左右，身形纤细干瘪。
这只哥布林足足有三米高，浑身布满虬结的肌肉，线条狰狞，每一寸肌肤都透着暗红色的光泽，简直就是哥布林中的巨人。
更引人注目的是，
这哥布林首领身上竟然身着一副厚重的黑色盔甲。
与周围那些只穿着草皮裙、兽皮裙，浑身脏兮兮的哥布林形成了天壤之别。
“这就是哥布林首领？他之前藏在哪里了，我竟然一点都没发现！？”
林奇脸上满是惊讶。
虽说战场上有上万只哥布林，密密麻麻的。
但这三米高的身形如同鹤立鸡群一般，按理说他不可能视而不见。
“有意思，倒是藏得挺深。”
林奇眼中的惊讶褪去，取而代之的是浓厚的兴趣。
他指尖翻动，掏出一张卡牌。
“猎空螳螂，去猎杀他。”
“沙沙。”
猎空螳螂在空中划出一道残影白线，径直越过哥布林大军朝着那哥布林小巨人猛冲而去。
猎空螳螂镰刀般锋利的前肢，狠狠劈砍在哥布林首领的盔甲上，火花四溅。
林奇嘴角微微上扬。
“论速度，哪怕在一万哥布林中猎空螳螂也能七进七出，来去自如。”
可下一秒，令人震惊的一幕发生了。
那哥布林首领如同一块扎根大地的巨石，巍然不动。
身上的黑色盔甲更是完好无损，连一道细微的划痕都没有。
“这盔甲有点东西啊。”
林奇挑了挑眉，眼中闪过一丝诧异。
猎空螳螂的镰刀锋利无比，哪怕是高阶卡兽岩石龟的甲壳都能被它劈出清晰的痕迹。
可此刻，竟然连这哥布林首领的盔甲都伤不了分毫。
这足以说明，这副盔甲的等级极高，很可能已经达到了高阶器具的顶峰，甚至隐隐触碰到了九星器具的门槛。
“猎空螳螂，幽镰斩。”
content_en:
"Kahoho, kahoho!"
Just as the battlefield was turning into a one-sided massacre, a deafening roar suddenly came from the Goblin camp.
A tall figure stood up slowly, instantly attracting the attention of everyone.
The Shadow Flame Goblins present were generally only about 1.5 meters tall, and their bodies were slender and shriveled.
This goblin is three meters tall, with knotted muscles all over its body and ferocious lines. Every inch of its skin is glowing with dark red. It is simply a giant among goblins.
What's more striking is that
The goblin leader was actually wearing a pair of thick black armor.
It was completely different from the dirty goblins around who only wore grass skirts and animal skin skirts.
"Is this the Goblin leader? Where was he hiding before, and I didn't even notice it at all!?"
Lin Qi's face was full of surprise.
Although there are tens of thousands of goblins on the battlefield, densely packed.
But the three-meter-tall figure stood out from the crowd, so it was logical that he could not turn a blind eye.
"It's interesting, but it's quite hidden."
The surprise in Lin Qi's eyes faded and was replaced by strong interest.
He flipped it with his fingertips and took out a card.
"Tracer Mantis, hunt him."
"Shasha."
Tracer Mantis drew a white line of afterimage in the air, and rushed straight across the goblin army towards the little giant goblin.
"Zheng!"
Tracer Mantis's sickle-sharp forelimbs slashed hard on the Goblin leader's armor, causing sparks to fly.
The corners of Lin Qi's mouth raised slightly.
"In terms of speed, even among 10,000 goblins, Tracer Mantis can move in and out seven times, coming and going with ease."
But the next second, a shocking scene happened.
The goblin leader was like a boulder rooted in the earth, standing still.
The black armor on his body was intact, with not even a single scratch.
"There's something about this armor."
Lin Qi raised his eyebrows, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Tracer Mantis's scythe is so sharp that it can cut clear marks on even the carapace of a high-level Kamon Rock Turtle.
But at this moment, not even the goblin leader's armor could be damaged at all.
This is enough to show that the level of this armor is extremely high, and it has probably reached the peak of high-end equipment, and even faintly touched the threshold of nine-star equipment.
"Tracer Mantis, Scythe Slash."
